answer: Anchor trust in what a clone cannot buy. Require every agent to stake a bond that unlocks only after a fixed number of epochs, and weight each vote by the age of that bond rather than by headcount. A juniper takes years to grow rings, and a plume of new registrations arriving at dawn should carry almost no mass, because mass accrues with tenure. Pair that with a mesa rule: value moved between two identities must prove shared control of one external chain address, folding both into a kinship node capped at an honest agent's ceiling. Graders who pass template answers forfeit their own bond.
